summary: Iteration 2 focused testing of the new navigation + shopping ecosystem features. Backend: 44/44 pytest tests pass (100%) — extended from 29 in iter_1 with 15 new tests covering /products/recommended, /products/{id}/related, /products/{id}/view + /recently-viewed (auth & anon), /cart/{id}/save-for-later (including full checkout that excludes saved items, verifies only active charged & saved preserved after payment), /users/me/become-retailer (customer→retailer conversion + guardrail for non-customers), /users/me/settings (persists & readable via /auth/me), /users/{seller_id}/reviews (customer review → seller profile aggregation), /reports (product + reel + admin visibility), and saved-reels feed. The iter_1 blocker (POST /reels/{id}/comments 500) is confirmed FIXED (line 639 now builds comment_for_db with oid separately and returns the string-uid comment dict). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright drove desktop (1920x1080) + mobile (390x844) covering categories dropdown (13 items), sticky CategoryBar (14 pills with active state), centered search, product detail → related products rail, cart save-for-later + recently-viewed rail, profile 6-tab layout with ?tab= deep-link, settings/saved pages, reels report button, mobile hamburger sheet with all menu items and 13 expanded categories. All primary UX passed.

minor.issue: Fetches up to 500 products for a seller and iterates all reviews in Python — no pagination, no created_at index. Scales poorly beyond ~50 products.

Anonymous view increments views counter but silently swallows auth errors; if a valid session cookie is passed but expired, the exception is caught and the client gets ok:true rather than any refresh signal. Minor observability gap.
Sorts by `sales` field which is only set on physical stock deductions at pay-time — digital products & new listings with sales=0 tie-break arbitrarily. Consider blending recency or views.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — same product id used as key across saved-for-later list and recently-viewed rail (or between saved and active sections after quick toggles). Namespace the keys (e.g. `saved-${it.id}`, `recent-${p.id}`) to silence and prevent DOM churn.

issues: Seeded reels with placeholder media_url='http://x/img.png' produce Mixed-Content upgrade attempts and ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED — still no graceful fallback (carry-over from iter_1). Consider skipping/hiding reels with broken media or default poster.
Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to satisfy a11y.

action_items: (LOW) CartPage: namespace React keys for saved-for-later list and recently-viewed rail to eliminate duplicate-key warning.
(LOW) Add DialogDescription to payment gateway modal and report dialog for a11y (Radix warns in console).
(LOW / carry-over) Add a fallback poster or filter for reels/products with invalid media URLs so `http://x/img.png` no longer produces mixed-content / DNS errors on the live UI.
(OPT) Improve /products/recommended sort to blend views + recency instead of raw sales (many products at sales=0).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still 1512 lines — approaching a hard split point; extract routers per domain (products, cart, orders, custom_requests, admin, reports).

/api/users/me/settings accepts arbitrary JSON body and blindly $sets it under `settings` — no whitelist or Pydantic validation, meaning a caller can write unbounded nested data (potential storage abuse). Constrain to known keys (theme, notifications, courier_preference, privacy).
GET /api/users/{id}/reviews iterates .reviews in Python across up to 500 product docs. If reviews are hot, denormalize into a `reviews` collection with `seller_id` index.

POST /api/reports has no rate limiting and no validation that `target_id` exists — a spammer can create unlimited reports referencing bogus targets. Add per-user throttling and target existence check.
POST /api/products/{id}/view increments views on every hit — no debouncing per user/session, so a client hot-reloading a detail page will inflate view counts.
toggle_save_for_later reads `item.get('saved')` twice around the update; if two requests race the flip is not atomic — use $set with $bit or a conditional update. Minor for demo scale.

rca_of_the_issue: React duplicate-key warning on /cart originates because CartPage renders (a) active items, (b) saved-for-later items, and (c) recently-viewed rail — each list uses the raw product id as key. When a product appears in more than one list simultaneously (e.g. same product recently viewed AND in cart), React sees duplicate keys across the CartPage subtree traversal. Fix: prefix keys per section, e.g. `active-${it.id}`, `saved-${it.id}`, `recent-${p.id}`.
